title: pm-dispatch: replace "hot file, one writer" with a claim-time and pre-push merge-tree overlap check (hot-file card A)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Filing gate ③: maintainer-directed. On 2026-11-15 the maintainer chose 「今天改规则,并立全部 6 张卡」 on the hot-file serialization decision card (consequence as shown: 取消 protocol.ts 独占、关闭 #25467 和 #24586;卡 A 到 F 交各车道立卡,大 PR 和上限门禁仍逐个等您批准). Measurements: the hot-file analysis report (project artifact), re-runnable on request. Cross-lane rule (2026-11-15): no live seat in the owning lane, so `domain:server` seat 5 files and builds it; the owning lane is notified.

## Card A (owning lane: skills; script: devx)

Replace the "hot file, one writer" rule with an overlap check.

1. A dependency-free script (scripts/pm/) that, for a branch, runs `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only` against each open PR head sharing a file and against origin/main, and lists conflicting files. Exit codes: 0 no textual overlap, 1 overlap (lists files), 2 usage.
2. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`: run it before a claim and before a push; queue only on a real textual overlap. Add: a card in the same series may start on the previous card's branch; new tests go in a new file named by card, never appended to a shared test file.
3. Relates to #33907 (PR #33938): build after it lands, same file.

Done when: the script has a self-test with a real two-branch conflict and a no-conflict case, and area-lease.md names it. Line-ceiling raises, if any, are ruled raises citing this card.
